question: Who gave title of "Father of the Nation" to Mahatma Gandhi?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Subhas Chandra Bose.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Subhas Chandra Bose** gave the title of** "Father of the Nation"** to Mahatma Gandhi in a **radio address** from **Singapore in 1944.**
 
• The title is** not officially recognized** by the Indian government.
 
• Rabindranath Tagore referred to Gandhi as** Mahatma (great soul)** but did not give him the title of "Father of the Nation."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• **Rabindranath Tagore** was a **poet, philosopher, and musician** who won the **Nobel Prize in Literature** in **1913. **

 
 
• He was also a close friend of Gandhi's and played an important role in** India's independence movement.**
 
 
 
• **Subhas Chandra Bose** was a prominent leader of the Indian National Congress who later formed the **Forward Bloc party. **
 
 
• **​**He is known for his radical approach to India's independence movement and his** alliance with Nazi Germany and Imperial Japan** during World War II.
 
 
 
• **Jawaharlal Nehru** was India's **first Prime Minister** and a close associate of Gandhi's.
 
 
• He played a key role in India's independence movement and was a leading figure in the **Indian National Congress.**
 
 
 
• **Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel** was a prominent leader of India's independence movement and served as the **country's first Deputy Prime Minister **and** Home Minister. **
 
 
• **​**He played a key role in the i**ntegration of the princely states** into India after independence.
